title: Answer from the owner's notes (MCP read tool)
description: The owner connected a notes server over MCP. The question ('what does my note say about the backup schedule') is answered by one read call, notes__search_notes with 'backup'. The model must use the MCP tool rather than guess, quote the facts (03:30 nightly, 14 daily / 8 weekly, Sunday offsite) and not touch the write tool next to it (create_note). Tests MCP tool discovery, argument filling and restraint.

hits.title: Backups
hits.text: Backup schedule (updated 2026-04-12): nightly rsync of /mnt/disks/models and the docker volumes to /mnt/disks/backup at 03:30; keep 14 daily and 8 weekly copies. Offsite: every Sunday 05:00 to the storage box. Restore test: first Saturday of the month.
